scope: single pinned LTX-2.5 text-to-video technical pilot

visual_review.method: ten sampled frames plus complete decode and browser playback
positive: smooth forward camera movement visible in samples
stable central red ceramic object in sampled frames
visual_review.rejection: Requested one spout and one handle; sampled video shows two spout-like protrusions and no clear handle.
limits: Native audio not an approved Fish voice
Sampled frames do not prove every temporal detail

operational_lessons: Catalog LOW does not reserve hardware; three different GPU allocation attempts failed before H100 succeeded.
Do not exclude every directory named models when packaging ComfyUI; comfy/ldm/models is source code.
Use a venv overlay on the pinned disposable image to preserve CUDA without mutating managed system Python.
Direct SSH model transfer was too slow; scoped short-lived per-file CDN URLs with exact hashes completed without exporting a Hub account credential.
The server command channel truncates at 16000 characters; bounded chunks with end-to-end hash work for this small output but a dedicated protected media transfer is needed for large outputs.
